title: The storm didn’t surprise Jesus.
paragraphs:
The storm didn’t surprise Jesus.
But it revealed the disciples.

Wind screaming.
Waves crashing into the boat.
Experienced fishermen panicking.

They cried out:
“Teacher, don’t you care that we are perishing?”

Many people claim strong faith —
until the storm arrives.

Do we trust Jesus only in calm waters…
or also when the waves rise?
Jesus stood and spoke three words:

The wind obeyed.
The sea surrendered.
Then He asked the real question:
“Why are you afraid? Do you still have no faith?”

Sometimes the storm isn’t meant to sink you.
It’s meant to test what your faith is actually resting on.
Has your faith ever been tested by a storm season in life?
